description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface declares four pure virtual methods for handling different OCI container events, such as start, stop, failure, and state change, each accepting a container name and a JSON object with event data.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class for handling OCI container events, requiring implementation of methods for start, stop, failure, and state change events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container starts, with container name and event data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container stops, with container name and event data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container fails, with container name and event data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container changes state, with container name and event data.
